summary: Enhance autonomous disk remediation for subactor caches and stale IDE version data

delivery.outcome: Enhance autonomous disk space remediation by recognizing subactor-search, virt-builder, tree-sitter, cargo, and android caches as safe to prune, and enable snap-old during service cleanup.
nonGoals: No personal directory scans or user-authored file deletions
No removal of JetBrains LocalHistory or active version caches
No breaking changes to CLI interface or retention policies

architecture.decision: Extend _USER_CACHE_SAFE and _CACHE_PATHS with regenerable developer tool caches (subactor-search, virt-builder, tree-sitter-language-pack), add cargo/android caches to _cleanup_build_caches, and trigger snap-old when clean_services is active and snap is present.
architecture.rollback: Revert via git commit/PR and reinstall stable package.
